export_interpolation_ai_help: An AI model draws the in-between frames. It copes with fast motion and edges that appear or disappear better than Optical flow, but it is much slower and needs a one-time download of about 11 MB.
export_interpolation_ai_levels: Low uses a lighter model and suits Good phones. Medium is the model to start with. High uses a larger model for the hardest scenes; keep it for Fast phones or short clips. On a recent top phone, 10 seconds of 1080p video at 30 to 60 fps take about half a minute to a minute; Basic phones can take 10 minutes or more.
export_interpolation_blend_help: The new in-between frames mix the two nearest frames like a quick cross-fade. Fast to export; fast motion can look ghosted.
export_interpolation_blend_levels: Low leans on the nearest frame, so there is less ghosting. Medium mixes the two frames evenly. High also mixes in the frames around them for the softest motion. Quick on every phone.
export_interpolation_flow_help: The app follows how each part of the picture moves and draws real in-between frames. Smoothest motion, but the export is slower and very fast motion can smear at the edges.
export_interpolation_flow_levels: Low tracks motion roughly and is the quickest; it suits Basic phones. Medium is the usual choice for Good phones. High tracks finer detail with more passes for cleaner edges; it is slow, so keep it for Fast phones or short clips.
export_interpolation_hint: Clips with a lower frame rate than the export are smoothed to match, for example 30 to 60 fps.
export_interpolation_off_help: Each clip shows its own frames. A 30 fps clip in a 60 fps export shows every frame twice, so motion can look a little stepped.

sounds_empty: No music or sounds were found on this device.
sounds_permission_body: Allow access to music and audio to see your sounds here. From Files works without it.
storage_permission_explain: On this Android version AbsentMotion needs storage access to save backups, exports and camera shots in your folders. Try again and allow it, or turn on Storage for AbsentMotion in the app settings.
structure_svg_empty: This SVG file has no shapes that can be imported.
structure_svg_unreadable: Could not read this SVG file.
svg_err_invalid: This file is not an SVG image.
template_add_failed: Could not add the template. Free some storage space.
template_finish_body:
Once you continue you can't return to this step.

Stay here to swap the template's media for your own.
template_hint_replace: Tap again to swap in your own media
template_hint_scale: Tap the corner icon to change scaling
template_leave_body:
Leaving now discards your changes.

Stay here to swap the template's media for your own.
textpath_nothing_below: There is no layer beneath this text to follow. Put a shape, a pen path or a drawing just beneath it.
the_media_picker_lists_only_albums: The media picker lists only albums and folders whose name contains Demo.
the_project_file_is_missing_or: The project file is missing or damaged, so nothing was changed.
theme_error_no_colours: No theme colors in this file
this_asset_pointed_to_a_project:
This asset pointed to a project that has been deleted.

Rebuild a project from this asset, or detach it and edit it directly?
track_hint_one: Drag the box onto a sharp detail that stays visible.
track_hint_two: Drag both boxes onto two details of the same object, far apart.
track_motion_cancelled: Tracking canceled. Frames already tracked keep their keyframes.
track_motion_done: Tracked %1$s frames. The keyframes are on %2$s.
track_motion_failed: This video could not be tracked.
track_motion_lost_at_frame: Tracking was lost at frame %1$s. Move the point back onto the same feature and tap Continue.
track_motion_no_area: This layer has no area to track.
track_motion_playhead_outside: Move the playhead inside the video clip first.
track_motion_too_little_detail: This spot has too little detail to follow. Move the point onto a sharp corner or texture and tap Continue.
track_motion_unavailable: Motion tracking is unavailable in this build.
transition_add_between: Add a transition between the two clips
transition_moved: Moved “%1$s” %2$s earlier so the clips overlap.
transition_needs_order: No cut here: one clip must start and end later than the other.
transition_needs_two: Select two clips to add a transition between them.
transition_needs_visual: Sound, camera and null layers cannot have transitions.
transition_shortened: Shortened to %1$s to fit the clips.
tutorial_delete_body: It was made only for the tutorial. Keep it if you want to look at it again.
tutorial_easing_body: Swipe the ruler to put the playhead between your two keyframes, then tap the curve button under ◆.
tutorial_effect_body: Open Effects, tap Add effect and pick one. Then drag one of its sliders.
tutorial_exit_body: You can continue later from Settings on the home screen.
tutorial_export_body: Tap Share to open Export, where you choose the format and size. You do not have to export now.
tutorial_finish_body: You know the basics now. Help and this tutorial are in Settings on the home screen. Have fun creating!
tutorial_gestures_body: Drag the picture to move it. Pinch to resize it and twist to rotate it.
tutorial_hint_between: First swipe the ruler to put the playhead between the keyframes.
tutorial_hint_effect_back: Open Effects again and drag one of your effect's sliders.
tutorial_hint_export_close: Have a look, then tap ✕ at the top left to go back.
tutorial_hint_second_keyframe: Now swipe the ruler a little, then drag the pad.
tutorial_hint_select: First tap a clip in the timeline to select it.
tutorial_hint_slider: Now drag one of its sliders. Tip: tap a number to type an exact value.
tutorial_hint_tools: Tap the arrow at the top left to go back to the tools.
tutorial_hint_unselect: First tap the arrow at the top left to unselect the layer.
tutorial_keyframes_body: Open Transform and tap ◆ to add a keyframe. Swipe the ruler to move the playhead, then drag the pad to move the layer.
tutorial_motion_body: Tap the round Animate button and pick an In, Out or Loop animation.
tutorial_note_restored: We added what this step needs.
tutorial_note_sample_picture: No picture chosen, so we added two sample pictures.
tutorial_note_sample_sound: No sound chosen, so we added a sample sound.
tutorial_offer_body: Learn the basics by making a short animation in a practice project. Your own projects stay untouched.
tutorial_picture_body: Tap +, open the Media tab and tap a photo. No photo handy? Tap Do it for me.
tutorial_safety_body: Your project saves by itself. The gear button opens Version history to bring back earlier versions. Backups are in Settings on the home screen.
tutorial_screen_body: Preview on top, play bar below it, timeline at the bottom. Every layer gets its own timeline row.
tutorial_sound_body: Tap +, open the Audio tab and pick a sound.
tutorial_split_body: Swipe the ruler to put the playhead on the clip, then tap Split to cut it.
tutorial_switch_body: Your project is saved. The tutorial uses its own practice project, so nothing in yours changes.
tutorial_text_body: Tap +, then Text. Type a short word and tap ✓ at the top right.
tutorial_timeline_body: Swipe the timeline to move through time, or tap ▶ to play. The middle line is the playhead.
tutorial_undo_body: Undo and Redo are the first two buttons in the play bar. Try Undo, then Redo.
tutorial_welcome_body: In about 5 minutes you will make a short animation and learn the basics. This is a practice project, so your own projects stay untouched.
unsupported_driver_features: The phone's graphics driver is missing features AbsentMotion needs to draw the preview and the export.
unsupported_no_vulkan: The phone's graphics driver would not start Vulkan, which AbsentMotion needs to draw the preview and the export.
unsupported_old_vulkan: AbsentMotion draws the preview and the export with the graphics chip through Vulkan 1.1, and this phone only has an older Vulkan version.
unsupported_skia: AbsentMotion's drawing engine does not work with this phone's graphics driver.
unsupported_still_usable: You can still see your projects, settings and crash logs, and back up your projects. Editing and exporting need the drawing engine.
unsupported_title: This phone cannot run the editor
unsupported_unknown: AbsentMotion's drawing engine could not start on this phone.
update_check_note: It only asks GitHub for the latest version number.
update_check_on_open: Check for a new version each time the app opens
update_err_checksum: The download did not match the checksum published with the release, so it was deleted.
update_err_connection: The connection was lost during the download. Try again to continue where it stopped.
update_err_file: The update could not be saved on this device.
update_err_install: Android could not install the update.
update_err_interrupted: The update did not finish because AbsentMotion was closed. Try again to continue where it stopped.
update_err_no_checksum: The release lists no checksum for this file, so it was not downloaded.
update_err_no_installer: This device has no installer that can install the update.
update_err_not_newer: The downloaded file is not newer than the installed app, so it was not installed.
update_err_offline: You are offline. Connect to the internet and try again.
update_err_removed: The downloaded update is no longer available on this device, so nothing was installed. Try again to download it.
update_err_secure: A secure connection to GitHub could not be made. Check the network and try again.
update_err_server: GitHub did not send the update (error %1$s). Try again later.
update_err_settings: This device cannot open the setting to allow installs. Allow AbsentMotion under Install unknown apps in the system settings.
update_err_signature: This update is signed with a different key than the installed app, so it cannot replace it. Nothing was changed.
update_err_storage: Not enough free space. The update needs about %1$s free.
update_err_untrusted: The download was redirected to an address outside the AbsentMotion releases, so it was stopped.
update_err_wrong_app: The downloaded file is not the right AbsentMotion version for this app, so it was not installed.
update_external: This copy did not come from an AbsentMotion GitHub release, so it cannot update itself. Get the update from where you installed it.
update_failed: Could not check, try again when you are online
update_metered: This connection is metered, for example mobile data. The download may use up your data plan.
update_not_installed: The update was not installed. You can install it now or later.
update_open_failed: No app on this device can open the link.
update_outdated: This may be fixed in the newer version (installed %1$s, newest %2$s).
update_permission_body: Android installs updates only from apps you allow. Tap Open Settings, turn on Allow from this source, then come back. Your projects stay as they are.
update_permission_denied: Installing updates is still not allowed. Open Settings and turn on Allow from this source, or cancel.
update_permission_first: Android installs updates only from apps you allow, so this is asked before the download. Tap Open Settings, turn on Allow from this source, then come back and the download starts. Your projects stay as they are.
update_waiting: Waiting for Android to install the update
voice_none_offline: No offline voices on this device
voice_unreadable: The voice could not be read back
xml_err_too_deep: Elements are nested more than %1$s levels deep
xml_err_too_many: The file has too many elements
your_video_ended_early_so_its:
Your video ended early, so its last frame is held.
Swap in a longer clip for a cleaner result.
